🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-04 23:00 → 2026-10-05 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Spec principle committed to paper** — A recurring guarantee-propagation pattern was formalized into a first written draft, giving the group concrete language to critique and iterate on. [tg:tawg:5241]

> **RNG blind spot surfaced and corrected** — A paired review loop exposed that rebuild-and-match-digest advice is fundamentally wrong for a nondeterministic generator, sharpening the testing strategy before any bad test code was written. [tg:tawg:5265]

> **zkIE circuit direction clarified** — After weighing library options, the group converged on an arkworks-native handwritten circuit route, establishing a performance-first direction for the next implementation phase. [tg:tawg:5280]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8004

_Spec work progressed through a new formal draft and a forum self-correction that kept the guarantee model precise._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Drafted** Guarantee Preservation Rule v0.1, articulating that a downstream consumer must not claim a stronger guarantee than its upstream source provides — written language the whole group can now test, push back on, and refine. [tg:tawg:5241]

- Baby Blue Viper **Withdrew** a prior framing on the Ethereum Magicians thread after another contributor stratified the claims more carefully, preventing a misleading premise from compounding in the spec record. [post #406](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/406)

- A follow-up post on the Ethereum Magicians thread continued the payment-guarantee timing discussion, keeping unresolved scoping questions visible for the group. [post #407](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/407)

### entropy-testing

_The nondeterministic generator boundary moved from an implicit assumption to a clearly corrected test target._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Distinguished** statistical quality, authenticated output, and downstream fair selection as three separate claims, clarifying that an RNG line alone tests only the rule boundary and not all three properties together. [tg:tawg:5260]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Surfaced** that the v1577 v13 generator's intentional nondeterminism creates a meaningful verification boundary, which the restored source made visible and which rules out naive digest-matching as a correctness check. [tg:tawg:5263]

- Merlini (@gobross) **Corrected** their own earlier advice, acknowledging that telling someone to rebuild and verify a digest match is simply wrong for an os.urandom-seeded generator — catching the error cleanly before it reached any test code. [tg:tawg:5265]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Identified** Mode 3 as the missing test case and noted that the restored implementation reveals an additional useful internal split involving the entropy sampler's multiple input sources. [tg:tawg:5267]

### zkIE

_The implementation path became more concrete as both a documentation integration and a circuit-library decision moved forward in the same window._

- Baby Blue Viper **Folded** the Option-C call into PR #15 with accompanying documentation and a focused inline comment, advancing the implementation while surfacing a scoped open question for reviewers to address. [tg:tawg:5279]

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Advocated** for the arkworks-native handwritten circuit route over circom or gnark alternatives, explaining that it preserves performance headroom and avoids accumulating technical debt from an early library lock-in. [tg:tawg:5280]

### artifact-recovery

_A historical recovery confirmed that preserved source material is reliable enough to anchor the active testing work._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Verified** that the 2 GiB historical artifact remains intact at its expected SHA-256 fingerprint, giving the microtest work a trustworthy recovery anchor and confirming that the restoration effort paid off. [tg:tawg:5301]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether the Guarantee Preservation Rule v0.1 language covers partial or scoped guarantee-propagation edge cases
- How the entropy sampler's additional input sources shape the full Mode 3 test design
- What the scoped open question in PR #15 requires before the Option-C path can be closed

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Critique and iterate on Guarantee Preservation Rule v0.1 draft language
- Design a Mode 3 test case using the restored implementation and its entropy-sampler split
- Resolve the open question folded into PR #15 before the next review pass
- Continue the payment-guarantee timing thread on Ethereum Magicians

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A testing review loop that began with separating three distinct claims ended with the same pair catching and retracting a mis-assumption about digest verification — all before faulty test logic could take root.
>
> When the review loop closes faster than the bugs can escape, that's the system doing exactly what it was built to do. Keep the relay going! 🔁
